description: One person's work over a period, for a status update: the work items they completed between `from` and `to` and the items still open, grouped by initiative, with exact counts, Console links and a `markdown` copy ready to paste. Any member may ask about any approved member (one person at a time); it lists only items the caller can already read. Archived items count. Find the uid with anyforge_list_members. Requires `read` scope.

by.description: Whose work counts: 'owner' (default; items assigned to them, items in initiatives they own and standalone items they filed) or 'assignee' (only items assigned to them).

from.description: First day of the period, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC, inclusive).

person.description: The member's uid; 'me' for the API key owner.

to.description: Last day of the period, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC, inclusive).

name: anyforge_get_work_summary
title: Get work summary
